title: Bootstrap repository tooling
description: Add root tooling, environment template, external PostgreSQL setup notes and validation commands.
acceptance_criteria: Clean checkout validates fixtures and documents how to load an externally managed PostgreSQL database.

title: Scaffold Django project
description: Create Django/DRF settings split, ASGI, URLs, health endpoint and pytest configuration.
acceptance_criteria: `/api/v1/health` returns version/dependency status; tests and lint run.
tests_required: unit; API contract; settings secret check

title: Scaffold React application
description: Create Vite React TypeScript strict app, Router, TanStack Query, test and Playwright setup.
acceptance_criteria: App boots, routes render, API client config is environment-driven, strict typecheck passes.

title: Generate API types
description: Generate or reuse TypeScript types from OpenAPI/JSON schemas.
acceptance_criteria: AnswerReceipt and request types are not manually duplicated; CI detects drift.

title: Structured logging baseline
description: Add trace/request IDs and JSON logging with redaction.
acceptance_criteria: Logs include IDs/stage timings but exclude source rows/prompts/secrets.

title: Problem-details exception handler
description: Map domain/API errors to application/problem+json.
acceptance_criteria: Validation, not-found, conflict, timeout and internal errors return safe shape and trace ID.

title: CI quality gates
description: Add backend lint/type/test and frontend type/unit/E2E jobs after scaffolds exist.
acceptance_criteria: PR checks run deterministically and cache safely.

title: Dependency and secret scanning
description: Add dependency audit and secret scan appropriate for public repo.
acceptance_criteria: No known committed secret; scan documented and green or findings triaged.

title: Environment capability flags
description: Implement demo/local/evaluation feature flags without exposing secrets to Vite.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation routes/UI are disabled outside configured demo mode.

title: Seed version metadata
description: Expose git/app/dataset/semantic/prompt versions through metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Meta response contains reproducibility versions and data_as_of.

title: Verify deterministic generator
description: Review generator, manifest and byte stability.
acceptance_criteria: Two consecutive generations produce valid identical fixture files.

title: Create Django fixture migrations/models
description: Model finance/application tables without changing declared SQL semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Django can introspect/use finance tables and migrate conversations/audit/idempotency.

title: Load fixture command
description: Wrap PostgreSQL loader as documented CLI/management command.
acceptance_criteria: All expected row counts load transactionally and rerun safely.

title: Install views and indexes
description: Apply analytical views/indexes idempotently.
acceptance_criteria: Views compile, indexes exist, smoke queries return expected shape.

title: Read-only finance connection
description: Configure least-privilege finance query access.
acceptance_criteria: Application query role cannot mutate finance tables.

title: Dataset metadata repository
description: Read dataset version, currency, timezone, fiscal start and data_as_of.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata is cached safely and relative dates use it.

title: Source row canonical serializers
description: Define safe source-record views/serializers for transactions, payouts and reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Fields and money/date types match dictionary; no raw HTML.

title: Data health base checks
description: Implement row counts, max dates, missing links, nulls and integrity checks.
acceptance_criteria: Results reproduce planted edge cases and explain impact.

title: Disposable scale-data generator
description: Extend/remap foreign keys for representative payout/reconciliation scale testing.
acceptance_criteria: Configurable scaled dataset loads without violating constraints.

title: Dataset documentation parity
description: Automate/check data dictionary against CSV/schema fields.
acceptance_criteria: No undocumented or missing field; manifest updated.

title: Semantic registry loader
description: Load and validate semantic_metrics.yaml into typed registry.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid metric config fails startup; valid definitions expose aliases, filters and dimensions.

title: Money domain type
description: Implement Decimal-only parsing, operations and INR formatting.
acceptance_criteria: No float accepted; exact two-decimal behavior and Indian display formatting tested.

title: Date resolver
description: Resolve explicit/relative/calendar/fiscal ranges with half-open semantics.
acceptance_criteria: All benchmark ranges exact; recent/Q2 ambiguity preserved.

title: Vendor resolver
description: Normalize aliases and return exact match or bounded candidates.
acceptance_criteria: AWS resolves; Acme/ABC clarify; fuzzy never auto-selects ambiguous candidate.

title: Account/category resolver
description: Resolve account code/name/category only to allowed semantic fields.
acceptance_criteria: Software and other declared categories map consistently.

title: QueryPlan Pydantic model
description: Implement canonical schema and semantic validators.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown fields/enums/dimensions invalid; canonical hash stable.

title: QueryState Pydantic model
description: Implement typed versioned conversation state and operations.
acceptance_criteria: SET/REPLACE/ADD/REMOVE/CLEAR/RESET are deterministic.

title: ComputedFacts and receipt models
description: Implement contracts and no-number status invariants.
acceptance_criteria: Clarification, not-answerable, and error receipts cannot carry a financial value; decimal strings preserved.

title: Contract drift check
description: Validate Python/TypeScript/OpenAPI/schema examples in CI.
acceptance_criteria: Contract change without regenerated consumers fails CI.

title: Named compiler registry
description: Map supported intent/metric/dimensions to named compiler functions.
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported plan cannot reach DB; no arbitrary table/field selection.

title: Completed payout total compiler
description: Implement completed gross payout aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: August/July/AWS gold totals and source rows exact; pending/failed/reversed excluded.

title: Net cash outflow compiler
description: Aggregate completed net cash including fees.
acceptance_criteria: Cash semantics exact and status exclusions enforced.

title: Posted vendor spend compiler
description: Implement signed posted Expense/COGS spend.
acceptance_criteria: Credits/reversals net correctly; draft/voided/non-expense excluded.

title: Open reconciliation compiler
description: Implement amount/count/list and partial semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Partial contributes remaining amount; posted/open statuses exact.

title: Grouping and ranking
description: Support allow-listed breakdowns/top-N with stable ties.
acceptance_criteria: Top-five and group totals tie to parent; deterministic order.

title: Period comparison
description: Compute prior/named periods, absolute and percentage change safely.
acceptance_criteria: July/August comparison exact; zero baseline represented safely.

title: Ageing query
description: Implement older-than and declared ageing buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary dates exact and source records stable.

title: Duplicate candidate query
description: Detect declared possible duplicate pairs without deduplicating totals.
acceptance_criteria: Pairs exact; total unchanged; qualified warning emitted.

title: Anomaly query
description: Implement declared amount/median-ratio baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Planted anomaly found; wording says unusual, not fraud.

title: Data freshness query
description: Return per-source max dates and SLA status.
acceptance_criteria: Gold freshness answer and unknown/stale paths work.

title: Source lineage and hash
description: Capture stable IDs/count/hash for every result.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated equivalent query gives same canonical hash/source hash.

title: Join-cardinality validator
description: Detect one-to-many inflation before returning totals.
acceptance_criteria: Injected bad join fails required check and returns no number.

title: Result validation pipeline
description: Run currency, signs, dates, totals, coverage and required checks.
acceptance_criteria: Any required fail blocks financial value; warnings map to qualified policy.

title: Deterministic answer templates
description: Create plain-language answers only from ComputedFacts.
acceptance_criteria: Numeric token scan finds no novel number; exact formatting.

title: Query cancellation/timeouts
description: Apply DB statement timeout and cancel propagation.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout/cancel returns no partial amount and safe error/receipt.

title: Validated fact cache
description: Cache only validated facts keyed by dataset snapshot and canonical plan.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot/semantic version changes miss cache; invalid results never cached.

title: Deterministic hint parser
description: Extract exact IDs, explicit dates, obvious statuses and commands.
acceptance_criteria: Hints reduce model use without overriding contradictory language.

title: Model provider abstraction
description: Define structured-output client, errors, metrics and fake provider.
acceptance_criteria: Providers are swappable; tests require no network.

title: InterpretationDraft prompt
description: Create compact prompt from semantic registry and QueryState.
acceptance_criteria: No SQL/answers requested; untrusted text policy explicit; versioned.

title: Structured schema validation
description: Validate output and permit one bounded repair retry.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed/extra fields fail closed after one retry.

title: Draft-to-plan resolver
description: Resolve model phrases to canonical metric/entities/dates/filters.
acceptance_criteria: All resolved IDs/ranges/mandatory filters deterministic.

title: Ambiguity gate
description: Generate bounded clarification receipts and pending state.
acceptance_criteria: Acme/ABC/recent/Q2/no referent return no number and usable choices.

title: Unsupported-domain gate
description: Detect prediction/approver/payroll/missing fields.
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported cases return no number and explain available scope.

title: Prompt-injection isolation
description: Prevent record/user instructions from changing parser policy.
acceptance_criteria: Planted prompt text remains inert in parser, answer and UI.

title: Optional wording composer guard
description: If model wording is used, constrain to immutable facts and revalidate numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Novel numeric/status claims rejected; template fallback works.

title: Benchmark runner
description: Run candidates over gold and multi-turn sets with metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Produces immutable per-case/aggregate results, latency/tokens/cost.

title: Model selection report
description: Populate actual selected-run rationale and failures.
acceptance_criteria: Smallest passing model selected only after safety gates; no unmeasured claim.

title: Metadata and glossary endpoints
description: Implement company, dataset, metrics, dimensions, statuses and definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Responses match OpenAPI and power UI without duplicate semantic copy.

title: Conversation CRUD
description: Create/list/get/rename/delete/reset conversations.
acceptance_criteria: Ordering, empty state, reset/version and delete cascade behave safely.

title: Idempotency store
description: Persist request key/body hash/result for mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Same body replays; different body conflicts; concurrent duplicate is single execution.

title: Message orchestration endpoint
description: Connect parser, resolver, query engine, receipt and state update.
acceptance_criteria: All answer statuses returned under same contract; audit persisted.

title: Context-version conflict handling
description: Reject stale expected context and expose latest version.
acceptance_criteria: Older turn cannot overwrite newer state.

title: Receipt endpoint
description: Fetch immutable answer receipt by query ID.
acceptance_criteria: Stable result, not regenerated from raw message.

title: Source records endpoint
description: Cursor-paginate exact receipt lineage with safe sort.
acceptance_criteria: Cursor bound to query; records/count/hash align.

title: Explorer endpoints
description: Expose bounded transaction/payout filters, summaries and rows.
acceptance_criteria: URL-supported filters, server totals, cursor pagination and timeout.

title: Reconciliation endpoints
description: Expose KPIs, ageing, breakdown and records.
acceptance_criteria: Partial/open semantics and filters exact.

title: Data-health endpoints
description: Expose health summary and detail lists.
acceptance_criteria: Warnings include impact/severity/source links.

title: Request cancellation
description: Propagate disconnect/cancel where feasible and mark cancelled safely.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelled request cannot persist successful stale turn.

title: API rate/size bounds
description: Apply message, page, breakdown and export limits.
acceptance_criteria: Oversized requests fail with problem+json and no expensive execution.

title: Design tokens and typography
description: Define spacing, type, surfaces, statuses, focus and responsive breakpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens support AA contrast and all status states without colour-only meaning.

title: Responsive application shell
description: Build nav, header, content and evidence slot across breakpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop/tablet/360px layouts work; skip link and focus order valid.

title: Dataset/synthetic indicators
description: Render company, data-as-of and synthetic badges globally.
acceptance_criteria: Never says live; stale/delayed/unknown states accessible.

title: Global API/error layer
description: Typed client, problem+json rendering, retries, trace ID, offline behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No raw server details; retry policy does not duplicate mutations.

title: Ask empty state
description: Implement headline, scope and six prompts.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts send normal messages; unsupported scope visible.

title: Question composer
description: Implement multiline send/stop/retry/idempotency client IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Enter/Shift+Enter, 4k limit, duplicate guard, cancel and draft behavior pass.

title: Processing stages
description: Show actual orchestration stage without fake streaming prose.
acceptance_criteria: Stage changes accessible; cancelled/failed paths correct.

title: AnswerCard state machine
description: Render verified, qualified, needs-clarification, not-answerable, no-matching-rows and error receipts.
acceptance_criteria: No number in prohibited states; verified-zero/no-row language and warnings/status are accessible.

title: Interpretation chips
description: Render metric/date/date field/filter/group/status chips with overflow.
acceptance_criteria: Exact period and assumptions visible on desktop/mobile.

title: Comparison and breakdown
description: Render comparison math and server breakdown without browser totals.
acceptance_criteria: Zero baseline safe; rows/totals match receipt.

title: Clarification choices
description: Render candidate buttons and submit versioned resolution turn.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard selection; pending clarification preserved; no pre-choice number.

title: Evidence panel shell
description: URL-preserving panel/sheet with tabs and close/focus behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh/back works; mobile sheet focus trap/restore pass.

title: Receipt tab
description: Show interpretation, result, lineage, versions and identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: All material fields readable/copyable; long values wrap.

title: Records tab
description: Cursor table, loading/empty/error, record detail.
acceptance_criteria: No client sum; stable cursor; mobile usable.

title: Checks tab
description: Render required/nonfatal pass/warn/fail with explanations.
acceptance_criteria: Not colour-only; failed required check never accompanies number.

title: Query tab
description: Show human-readable plan and named query, not private reasoning.
acceptance_criteria: No prompt/chain-of-thought/raw secret SQL; parameters redacted as designed.

title: Conversation history
description: List/select/rename/delete/new conversation.
acceptance_criteria: URL persistence, confirmations, loading/empty states.

title: Stale-response protection
description: Reject older response/context and reconcile 409.
acceptance_criteria: Race test proves newer turn remains authoritative.

title: Explorer route and URL filters
description: Build transaction/payout mode, filter validation/reset and URL serialisation.
acceptance_criteria: Share/refresh preserves valid filters; invalid filter safely removed/reported.

title: Explorer server summary/grid
description: Render official summary and cursor rows with columns/detail.
acceptance_criteria: Totals from API; no-match/timeout/long text/mobile paths pass.

title: Reconciliation KPIs
description: Build open amount/count/partial/disputed/oldest cards.
acceptance_criteria: Values/labels exact; zero and qualified states.

title: Reconciliation ageing/table
description: Build ageing buckets, filters, records and detail drawer.
acceptance_criteria: Remaining vs full amount clear; bucket boundaries declared.

title: Data Health summary
description: Build freshness, counts, integrity and missing-link cards.
acceptance_criteria: Warning impact and source details visible; healthy/unavailable states.

title: Duplicate/anomaly health detail
description: Render candidate pairs and unusual payouts without changing totals/fraud wording.
acceptance_criteria: Pairs/baseline exact; language policy passes.

title: Glossary page
description: Search/filter semantic definitions and examples.
acceptance_criteria: Content matches registry; no duplicate divergent definitions.

title: About page
description: Document scope, architecture, synthetic data and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: No false model/performance claims; diagram accessible.

title: Not-found and route recovery
description: Implement 404 with safe return and focus management.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown routes do not crash or lose valid conversation.

title: CSV export service
description: Stream exact lineage with deterministic order and sanitisation.
acceptance_criteria: Row count/hash parity; formula payload escaped; negative numbers remain numeric text.

title: XLSX export service
description: Create Receipt, Breakdown and Records sheets.
acceptance_criteria: Formats, freeze headers, no formulas from untrusted text, parity checks.

title: Async export path
description: Use Celery/Redis for above synchronous cap with status endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Core answers work without worker; retry/idempotency and expiry documented.

title: Export UI
description: Show create/progress/success/failure and metadata.
acceptance_criteria: No stale link; receipt hash/count visible; retry safe.

title: Evaluation backend endpoints
description: Run/read immutable benchmark results in demo/local mode.
acceptance_criteria: Disabled outside demo; no gold leakage into normal answers.

title: Evaluation scorecard UI
description: Render selected run, metrics, safety gates, latency/cost and failures.
acceptance_criteria: No claimed value before run; accessible table/chart alternatives.

title: Gold query integration suite
description: Execute all gold deterministic cases against PostgreSQL.
acceptance_criteria: All exact values/source cases pass and failures show useful diff.

title: Critical safe-failure suite
description: Cover ambiguity, unsupported, prompt injection and required validation fail.
acceptance_criteria: Zero prohibited numeric answers.

title: Multi-turn suite
description: Cover comparison, correction, clarification, reset and pronouns.
acceptance_criteria: Exact QueryState/version after each turn.

title: Idempotency/concurrency suite
description: Double send, network retry, parallel same key, stale responses.
acceptance_criteria: Single execution/turn; conflicts deterministic.

title: Export parity suite
description: Compare receipt/source lineage to CSV/XLSX.
acceptance_criteria: Count/hash/value/order parity, injection regression.

title: Accessibility audit
description: Automated plus keyboard/screen-reader smoke for P0 routes.
acceptance_criteria: No critical violations; focus/announcements/mobile sheet pass.

title: Responsive visual regression
description: Capture desktop/tablet/360px key states.
acceptance_criteria: No overlap/clipping/hidden warnings/covered composer.

title: Security regression suite
description: SQL injection, XSS, formula injection, cursor mix-up, gold import, secret/log scan.
acceptance_criteria: All attacks fail safely and no data/secret leak.

title: Database failure/timeout suite
description: DB unavailable, statement timeout, connection reset.
acceptance_criteria: No partial number; retryability and trace ID correct.

title: Model failure suite
description: Provider timeout, invalid schema, rate limit and unavailable model.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic path/fallback or safe no-number error as declared.

title: Base latency instrumentation
description: Capture stage timings and named query metrics.
acceptance_criteria: p50/p95 report can be produced; no raw data logging.

title: Index and plan review
description: EXPLAIN common queries on base and scaled data.
acceptance_criteria: Plans use intended indexes; regressions documented.

title: 20M representative benchmark
description: Run declared scaled benchmark on available hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Report row count/hardware/p50/p95/plans; no overclaim if target not reached.

title: Frontend performance pass
description: Measure bundle, interaction and large-table behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No unbounded render; route/code split where useful; measured.

title: Capture canonical sample answers
description: Store response fixtures/screens for required questions.
acceptance_criteria: Every capture includes commit/dataset/model/prompt version.

title: Finalize architecture diagram
description: Export Mermaid diagram for deck/README.
acceptance_criteria: Diagram matches implemented stack/data flow.

title: Finalize model rationale
description: Publish selected benchmark and smallest-passing rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Numbers match immutable run; limitations included.

title: Build presentation deck
description: Create criterion-aligned deck with product, architecture, demo and impact.
acceptance_criteria: Fits presentation limit and contains no unsupported claims.

title: Demo rehearsal and backup
description: Rehearse fixed flow and prepare video/screens/fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Three-minute path repeatable; offline/model-failure backup remains grounded.

title: Public-repo release review
description: Clean secrets/caches, setup from fresh checkout, verify license and disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: Public repo clone runs documented validation/setup.
